spans.s:
(इ) युगि r. 1st cl (युंगति)
To except, to abandon.

n. (-गं)
1 A pair, a couple, a brace.
2 An age, as the Kṛta, Tretā, Dvāpara, and

Kali.
3

A lustre, or period of five years.
m. (-गः)
1 A yoke.
2 A measure of four cubits.
3 A drug, commonly Ṛddhi.
E.
युज to join, aff. अच्, and the final changed.

m. (-कः)
The pin of a yoke.
E.
युग a yoke, and कील a pin or bolt, कन् added.

m. (-यः)
Destruction of the world.
E.
युग, and क्षय destruction.

mn. (-रः-रं)
1 The pole of a carriage, or wood to which the yoke is fixed.
2 The name of a mountain.
E.
युग a yoke, धृ to hold or support, खच् aff.

ind.
1 At one time, at once.
2 Together, conjointly.
E.
यु to join, गपतक् aff.

m. (-त्रः)
Mountain ebony: see the next.

m. (-कः)
Mountain ebony, (Bauhinia variegata.)
f. (-त्रिका)
The Sisu tree, (Dalbergia Sisu.)
E.
युग a pair, and पत्र a leaf, aff. कन्, double-leaved.

m. (-गः)
A young ox in training.
E.
युग a yoke, पार्श्व a side, and ग who goes, or with कन् aff. युगपार्श्वंक m. (-कः.)

n. (-लं)
A pair, a brace, a couple.
E.
युग a pair, लच् aff.

m. (-कः)
A year.
E.
युग an age, and अंशक a part.

m. (-न्तः)
1 A destruction of the universe.
2 The end of an age.
E.
युग an age, either generally or individually, and अन्त end.

m. (-न्धुः)
A real friend, a friend in need.
E.
युगान्त, and बन्धु a friend.

n. (-ग्मं)
1 A pair, a couple, a brace.
2 Mixing, uniting.
3 A couple of verses.
E.
युज to join, Uṇādi aff. मक्, and the final changed.

n. (-कं)
1 A couple.
2 A couple of verses connected by the construction of the sentence, the sense being completed only by the two together.
E.
कन् added to the last.

m. (-त्रः)
Mountain ebony.
E.
युग्म a couple, and पत्र a leaf, double-leaved.

f. (-का)
A timber tree, (Dalbergia Sisu.)
E.
युग्म a pair, and पत्र a leaf, कन् added, fem. form.

m. (-मः)
A plant, (Asclepias rosea.)
E.
युग्म double, फल fruit, and उत्तम best.

mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं)
Fit or proper to be yoked or harnessed.
n. (-ग्यं)
Any vehicle or conveyance.
m. (-ग्यः)
An animal yoked.
E.
युज to join, aff. यत् or क्यप्.
